Field.description: One value picked out of JSON, shown as a stat.

pointer.description:
JSON Pointer to the value, e.g. `/queue/length` or `/items/0/name`.
A list shows its length.

oneOf.description: A view or a widget when the data is one, else indented JSON, else text.
A view (`{status, summary, root}`) or one widget (`{type, ...}`).

fields.description: Values to pick out of a JSON file, each shown as a stat.

lines.description: Lines of text shown, from the top.

markdown.description: Render text as markdown. Default: true for `.md` and `.markdown` files.

name.description: Tile title. Default: the file name.

path.description:
File to show. `~/` is expanded; a relative path starts from the
config file's folder.

watch.description:
Watch the file for changes. With `false` it is checked on each
refresh instead (every second, or the module's `refresh:`).

entries.description: Shows a file another program writes: a view or widget in the dashboard's JSON, values picked out of any JSON, or text. Watches the file and shows it again when it changes. Add it several times with `builtin: file`.
entries.name: File
